source_snapshot.title: What should employer do if domestic worker stops working?
source_snapshot.text: Dubai: Employers in the UAE must report a domestic worker's absence within five days if the worker stops reporting for duty without a valid reason and their whereabouts are unknown, the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation (MoHRE) has said.The ministry clarified that employers are required to submit a report when a domestic worker leaves work without their knowledge and they are unable to establish the worker's whereabouts or contact them..Get updated faster and for FREE: Download the Gulf News app now - simply click here..The report, officially known as a Domestic Worker Absence from Work complaint, must be submitted through the ministry's approved service channels within five days of the worker's unexplained absence.How employers can report an absent domestic workerEmployers can submit the report through the official MoHRE website or the MOHRE UAE mobile app.They should access the ministry's domestic worker services, select the absence-from-work reporting service, complete the application with the required details and submit it for processing.The ministry's official guidance confirms that the five-day reporting requirement applies specifically to domestic workers. It differs from the rules governing private-sector employees, for whom an absence report generally applies after more than seven consecutive days.Employers can also seek guidance on the application process or follow up on requests through the ministry's customer service number: 600590000.MoHRE urged employers to consult its official website for details of the application procedures and available channels..UAE workers can report 11 types of labour violations to MOHRE.UAE fines 42 domestic worker recruitment offices over 135 labour law violations.UAE outlines four cases requiring domestic worker agencies to issue refunds.How to report unpaid salaries anonymously in the UAE

claims.claim: Employers must report a domestic worker's absence within five days if the worker stops reporting for duty without a valid reason and their whereabouts are unknown.
The report must be submitted through the official MoHRE website or mobile app.
For private-sector employees, the absence report applies after more than seven consecutive days.
A customer service number 600590000 is available for consultations.

title: What should employer do if domestic worker stops working?
summary_ru: 🚨 Что делать работодателю, если домашний работник перестал выходить на работу в ОАЭ Работодатели должны сообщить о пропаже домашнего работника в Министерство человеческих ресурсов и эмиратизации (MoHRE) в течение пяти дней, если работник отсутствует без уважительной причины и его местонахождение неизвестно. Отчет подается через официальный сайт MoHRE или мобильное приложение. Для частных сотрудников срок подачи отчета составляет более семи дней отсутствия. 📞 Для консультаций доступен номер службы поддержки 600590000.
